newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan commodity panel says mulling lower fees.
newsitem.headline: Japan commodity panel says mulling lower fees.

text.p: A government panel on Tuesday discussed ways to boost Japan's commodity futures markets, particularly by lowering commission fees, a Trade Ministry official said.
The Commodity Exchange Council, an advisory body to Japan's trade and agriculture ministers, is looking at lowering commission fees and simplifying procedures for listing new contracts, he said.
Trade house officials have cited high fixed commission rates as a key obstacle to expanding liquidity in the futures markets.
The issue of commissions is sensitive, however, as Japanese commodity brokerages rely on them for most of their revenues.
